metaDescription: Order custom two tone drawstring backpacks for your team or event. Perfect for giveaways, trade shows, and more. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Two tone drawstring backpacks add a pop of color and contrast that single-color bags can't match. Whether you're branding for a school event, corporate giveaway, or trade show, the two-tone design lets you coordinate with your logo colors or create a sporty look. Our Recycled PET Two-Tone Drawstring Backpack combines eco-friendly materials with a vibrant dual-color scheme, making it a standout promotional item that recipients will actually use.
heroAltText: Custom two tone drawstring backpacks in contrasting colors with logo imprint, perfect for promotional giveaways and events.
